```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
export * as zDirectNs from "./target-direct_js.mjs";
export * as aImportedNs from "./target-imported_js.mjs";
import "./shared_js.mjs";

// NAMESPACE OBJECT: ./target-observed.js
var target_observed_namespaceObject = {};
__webpack_require__.r(target_observed_namespaceObject);
__webpack_require__.d(target_observed_namespaceObject, { 
  value: () => (value) });


// ./target-observed.js
const value = "observed";

// ./index.js
const shared = __webpack_require__("./shared.js");








const observedKeys = Object.keys(target_observed_namespaceObject);



const entryShared = shared.F;

it("should preserve entry namespace exports across target chunks", async () => {
  const mod = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ "./main.mjs");
  expect(shared.u).toEqual(["direct", "imported"]);

  expect(mod.zDirectNs.foo).toBe("shared:direct-private");
  expect(mod.zDirectNs.bar).toBe("DROP_BAR_SENTINEL");
  expect(mod.zDirectNs.collision).toBe("target-collision");
  expect(Object.keys(mod.zDirectNs)).toEqual(["bar", "collision", "counter", "directOnly", "foo", "increment"]);
  expect(mod.counter).toBe(0);
  mod.increment();
  expect(mod.zDirectNs.counter).toBe(1);
  expect(mod.counter).toBe(1);
  expect(mod.aImportedNs.foo).toBe("shared:imported-private");
  expect(mod.aImportedNs.bar).toBe("DROP_IMPORTED_BAR_SENTINEL");
  expect(mod.aImportedNs.default).toBe(42);
  expect(Object.keys(mod.aImportedNs)).toEqual(["bar", "default", "foo"]);
  expect(mod.observedKeys).toEqual(["value"]);
  expect(Object.keys(mod.observedNs)).toEqual(["value"]);
  expect(mod.observedNs.value).toBe("observed");
  expect(mod.directOnly).toBe("direct-only");
  expect(mod.collision).toBe("shared:direct-private");
  expect(mod.entryShared).toBe("shared");
});

export { entryShared, observedKeys, target_observed_namespaceObject as observedNs };
export { counter, directOnly, foo as collision, increment } from "./target-direct_js.mjs";

```

```mjs title=shared_js.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";

__webpack_require__.add({
"./shared.js"
/*!*******************!*\
  !*** ./shared.js ***!
  \*******************/
(__unused_rspack_module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
const sharedValue = eval('"shared"');
const trace = [];

__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
}, {
  F: sharedValue,
  u: trace
});


},
});
export {};

```

```mjs title=target-direct_js.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
import "./shared_js.mjs";

// ./direct-private.js
const directPrivate = "direct-private";

// ./target-direct.js
const shared = __webpack_require__("./shared.js");



shared.u.push("direct");

const foo = `${shared.F}:${directPrivate}`;
const bar = "DROP_BAR_SENTINEL";
const collision = "target-collision";
const directOnly = "direct-only";
let counter = 0;
function increment() {
  counter++;
}

export { bar, collision, counter, directOnly, foo, increment };

```

```mjs title=target-imported_js.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
import "./shared_js.mjs";

// ./imported-private.js
const importedPrivate = "imported-private";

// ./target-imported.js
const shared = __webpack_require__("./shared.js");



shared.u.push("imported");

const foo = `${shared.F}:${importedPrivate}`;
const bar = "DROP_IMPORTED_BAR_SENTINEL";
/* export default */ const target_imported = (42);

export { bar, foo };
export default target_imported;

```
